sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Ancient armor are resource nodes found throughout the Mistlands which require a Black metal pickaxe or better to harvest. Along with Ancient swords, they can provide players with easy access to Scrap iron and Copper scrap from within the Mistlands biome.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text: • Randomly located throughout the Mistlands Ancient armor often spawns alongside one or more Ancient swords

sections.heading: Drops
sections.text:
There are two variants of ancient armor:
• A helmet with most of its righthand side missing, which has 33 nodes
• A helmet missing both its back half and a chunk from its forehead, which has 20 nodes
Each node may drop the following when mined (using a Black metal pickaxe or better):
On average, variant 1 will drop 16.5 each of scrap iron and copper scrap, whereas variant 2 will drop 10 of each on average.
